label: UPI Collect Scam
description: Fraudulent collect requests, deceptive QR codes, and requests to enter UPI PIN to receive money.
key_keywords: collect request;qr code;scan qr;approve payment;receive cashback;enter pin to receive
primary_modus_operandi: Fraudster sends a collect request or QR code claiming victim will receive money. Entering UPI PIN transfers money OUT of victim's account.

label: Phishing Link
description: Malicious links mimicking bank portals, KYC verification forms, or utility disconnection alerts.
key_keywords: click here;verify kyc;update pan;account blocked;electricity disconnected;bijli vibhag;bit.ly;tinyurl
primary_modus_operandi: Victim clicks on a spoofed link that steals bank credentials, PAN details, or netbanking passwords.

label: OTP Fraud
description: Social engineering to manipulate victims into revealing their One-Time Password.
key_keywords: share otp;tell otp;verification code;6 digit code;confirm otp;bank verification
primary_modus_operandi: Fraudster pretends to be bank staff, telecom operator, or courier agent needing the OTP to authorize an unauthorized transaction.

label: Fake Refund Scam
description: Claims of accidental debits, excess payment refunds, or e-commerce returns requiring customer action.
key_keywords: refund pending;excess payment;order cancelled;refund credit;claim refund;reversal
primary_modus_operandi: Fraudster lures victim with a refund, then tricks them into sharing bank details or approving an outward payment request.

label: Fake Loan Scam
description: Predatory instant loan apps offering unverified loans with hidden fees, advance charges, or blackmail.
key_keywords: instant loan;no cibil;pre-approved loan;disbursement fee;loan approved;fast cash
primary_modus_operandi: Victim installs an unauthorized loan app that extracts phone contacts/photos or demands upfront processing fees before disappearing.

label: Fake Job Offer
description: Work-from-home offers, YouTube/Google map review ratings, and Telegram task scams demanding registration fees.
key_keywords: work from home;part time job;earn daily;rating task;youtube like;registration fee;telegram job
primary_modus_operandi: Victim is offered high daily earnings for simple tasks, paid small amounts initially, then coerced into depositing large sums to unlock earnings.

label: Lottery / Prize Fraud
description: Deceptive claims of winning lotteries (KBC, car, lucky draw) requiring advance taxes or processing fees.
key_keywords: lottery winner;kbc lucky draw;congratulations;won car;claim prize;processing fee;customs fee
primary_modus_operandi: Victim is told they won a jackpot but must pay taxes, customs clearance, or registration charges upfront.

label: SIM Swap Fraud
description: Deceiving users into upgrading or porting their SIM card, allowing attackers to intercept banking OTPs.
key_keywords: sim swap;5g upgrade;sim block;mnp request;port number;esim qr
primary_modus_operandi: Fraudster convinces victim to send an MNP port code or scan an eSIM QR under the guise of 4G to 5G upgrade, capturing phone line.

label: Investment / Crypto Scam
description: Unrealistic promises of guaranteed daily returns, high-yield crypto trading, or VIP stock tipping groups.
key_keywords: guaranteed return;daily profit;crypto trading;double money;telegram trading;vip tips;forex
primary_modus_operandi: Victim is lured into a fraudulent investment portal showing fake profits, but withdrawals are blocked until exorbitant fees are paid.

label: Voice Phishing / Digital Arrest
description: Phone calls or video calls impersonating police, CBI, customs, or telecom officials threatening legal action.
key_keywords: digital arrest;cbi officer;police case;illegal parcel;customs seized;trai disconnection;arrest warrant
primary_modus_operandi: Fraudster impersonates law enforcement, alleges victim's Aadhaar was used in money laundering/drugs, and extorts money under digital arrest.

label: Legitimate / Normal Message
description: Authentic bank debit/credit alerts, genuine order updates, verified OTPs, or regular safe communications.
primary_modus_operandi: Normal transactional communication that poses zero threat to user financial safety.
